summary: Default bail under Section 167(2) Cr.PC; personal liberty under Article 21; piecemeal chargesheets; maintainability of Article 32 petition; statutory bail as fundamental right; continuation of remand beyond stipulated period; preliminary objection rejected; investigation pending not a ground to deny default bail; filing supplementary chargesheets to circumvent bail impermissible.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.12, s.13(2) r/w s.13(1)(d)
final_judgment: Writ petition allowed; petitioner's husband entitled to default bail; direction for release issued.
